leaf.note: goat's-foot: broad thick blade deeply notched at the apex

ground.silhouette: trailing vine mat of notched round leaves, pink trumpets

growth.juvenile_note: Epigeal: two broad, deeply notched, butterfly-shaped cotyledons, then thick, glossy, two-lobed 'goat's-foot' leaves on a trailing stem. The seedling runs straight out over the sand as a cord-like runner that roots at the nodes and branches, spreading many metres into a net of runners and leathery leaves across the upper beach and foredune.
growth.source: SANBI PlantZAfrica (flowers pink-violet, open one morning, bees main pollinators, capsule 12-17 mm, seeds need scarification); ANPSA (flowers 20-25 mm wide, last one day, any time of year, fast spreading); Wikipedia (runners several m, rarely 30 m, floating hairy seeds). Plant lifespan estimated.

fruiting.source: SANBI PlantZAfrica (funnel flowers 30-60 mm long, pink to violet, one-day, bees plus butterflies and moths, spherical capsule 12-17 mm with 4 floating hairy seeds); ANPSA (flowers year-round in the tropics). Fruit set, ripening, hang, rot and crop estimated.

traits.note: leaf/trunk/petiole derived from the plant's shape class; per-species detail where the entry carries it (aroids, cannabis)

leaf.note: encrusting red alga: pink calcified crust

ground.silhouette: pink calcified crust on reef rock

growth.juvenile_note: Spores settle on bare reef rock and within days to weeks grow into tiny, pink, flat, disc-shaped crusts a few mm wide. Discs spread at the margin and merge into a hard, stony, pink to mauve crust with a smooth, faintly glossy surface that paves and cements the reef crest. It sheds its thin surface layer now and then, which helps keep it free of fouling.
growth.source: Wikipedia Coralline algae (crusts expand 0.1-80 mm a year; intertidal to 270 m; Hydrolithon onkodes forms 'castles' with the chiton Cryptoplax). Growth, age at first conceptacles and crust longevity for P. onkodes estimated from crustose coralline literature.

ground.silhouette: clump of chained green calcified discs

growth.juvenile_note: No seedling stage to draw: new plants mostly grow from broken-off pieces that anchor with fine rhizoids and add a new flat, kidney-shaped segment almost every night (green at first, hardening white-green with lime within ~1-2 days), building branched chains like tiny prickly-pear pads that tangle into a cushion. After spawning the whole thallus bleaches white and dies.
growth.source: Wikipedia (Halimeda: segments 60-80% aragonite, calcification from ~36 h; sexual reproduction completed in ~36 h and holocarpic, leaving the thallus white and dead; lifespan a few months to a year; spreads by fragmentation; H. opuntia up to ~54 g CaCO3 per m2 per yr). Timings estimated.

traits.native_range: underwater — Caulerpa racemosa, pantropical reef sand and rubble, runners with grape-like bladders 3-15 cm — Wikipedia

leaf.note: green alga: runners bearing grape-like bladders

ground.silhouette: green runner mat studded with grape-like beads

growth.juvenile_note: No seedling: new plants start from torn fragments or swimming gametes' zygotes. A fragment glues itself down with colourless rhizoids within days and runs a pale green stolon over sand or rock, sending up short upright branches covered in little glossy green grape-like spheres. The whole plant is a single giant cell with many nuclei.
growth.source: AlgaeBase / Guiry (Caulerpa: siphonous coenocytic thallus, stolons with erect ramuli, holocarpic sexual reproduction, spread by fragments); Mediterranean studies of C. racemosa var. cylindracea (stolons grow ~1-2 cm/day in summer, seasonal die-back); values estimated

bark.note: alga; short stipe, no stem surface

ground.silhouette: stiff brown bushlet of toothed top-shaped blades

growth.juvenile_note: A germling from a settled zygote (or a regrowing holdfast): a tiny disc holdfast with a few flat, leaf-like blades. As it grows the axis lengthens and the 'leaves' become stiff, top-shaped (turbinate) blades with a toothed triangular rim and an air bladder inside, stacked spirally up an erect stem 5-30 cm tall.
growth.source: PROSEA Turbinaria (T. ornata 20-30 cm; young populations appear Jan-May and receptacles develop Oct-Dec in the Philippines); Univ. Hawaii reef algae pages (reproductive at 2-20 cm, thalli scoured off in winter, perennial holdfast regrows blades, spreads by fragments); Wikipedia (buoyant fronds raft).
